notes.title: Major update announcement / New mode addition
notes.notes:
Dear Sushi fans, we apologize for the long wait!
We are planning a major update to Sushi King to add a new mode between June and July.

While based on the current mahjong-based mode, this mode will allow you to enjoy sushi in a different way than before!

・Choose the sushi you are dealt in Sushi Drift!

・Use Priority Tickets to get priority sushi!

・Order sushi to get the set you want!

・Use Aging to increase your score!

We also want to make some improvements to the program and UI.

Please check Developer X for more details!

Please wait a little longer until the update.

notes.title: [Important] Regarding the suspension of the random matching battle function
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Sushi King".
During early access, the game Sushi King will release a smartphone version.
After the update on Friday, December 13, 2024,
We would like to suspend the [b]'Random Matching Battle' function[/b] in the PC version.
[b](*Friendly matches can be played as before.)[/b]

*If the current issue is resolved, the random matching function may be restored.

We would like to sincerely apologize to everyone who has been playing Matching Matches on a daily basis and to everyone who has been looking forward to Matching Matches.
Also, considering the number of days required for debugging the smartphone version, please allow a short period of time for installation after contacting us.
Since random matching matches will be suspended, we would like to enhance the single-player elements.


The following two reasons were the main reasons.

-To prevent dissatisfaction with matching due to the small number of matching users from becoming the essence of this game.

・As a result of speaking with the server we are renting, it is difficult to resolve the technical issue.

[b] ■To prevent dissatisfaction with matching due to the small number of matching users from becoming the essence of this game. [/b]

This issue has been present since release.
As for me, I am unknown and it will probably take some time for this game to be known by many people.
Since we decided to release the smartphone version from the time the PC version was released, we expected more players.

However, due to my lack of ability, the number of matching users did not increase after that.
This game was sometimes criticized for not matching.

From the time I developed this game, my goal was to have fun playing with friends and acquaintances.
I'm saddened that ``not matching'' makes the game unenjoyable for users.
We have taken these actions.

[b] ■After talking with the server we are renting, it is difficult to resolve the technical issue. [/b]

There are two points below.
- It turned out to be difficult to increase the number of playable elements for waiting users, such as having CPU battles during the waiting time for matching.
(After checking with the server I was renting from and conducting several months of verification myself, I determined that it would be difficult.)

・There is a way to intentionally induce bugs in the smartphone version, and the server and game cannot handle it.
(If you play normally, you will not encounter this bug.)

It's a big decision, but we would like to make improvements so that everyone can enjoy "Sushi King" even more.
Thank you for your continued support of "Sushi King".
*Please note that we may edit this community text depending on circumstances such as incorrect wording or lack of explanation.
